name: gridpath
description: Let Claude edit your real .xlsx files. Every change opens a local review page: see changed cells before/after, accept or reject, then save. Untouched parts of the workbook stay byte-identical.
long_description:
GridPath gives Claude a safe way to edit the Excel files you already have.

- **Edits the real file.** Saves rewrite only the parts an edit touched; charts, pivots, macros, add-in data and custom XML come back byte-identical.
- **Real formulas.** A calculation engine runs inside the extension, so Claude reads evaluated values and writes formulas that work when the file opens in Excel.
- **Review before save.** Each change returns a local review link with changed cells highlighted and before/after values. With *Require review* on, only that page can write the file.

Choose the folders Claude may open below. Files outside them are refused.

tools.name: describe_workbook
tools.description: Structural map of a workbook: sheets, headers, sections, named ranges.

tools.name: find_rows
tools.description: Find rows by label across sheets.

tools.name: read_range
tools.description: Read evaluated values and formulas from a range.

tools.name: set_cell
tools.description: Write a value or formula to one cell (pending until saved).

tools.name: set_range
tools.description: Write a block of values or formulas (pending until saved).

tools.name: run_script
tools.description: Run a sandboxed JavaScript edit against the workbook as one reviewable batch.

tools.name: save_workbook
tools.description: Write pending changes into the .xlsx through the surgical patcher.

allowed_directories.title: Folders Claude may edit
allowed_directories.description: Workbooks outside these folders are refused.

review_required.title: Require review before saving
review_required.description: When on, Claude cannot save; you accept and save from the review page it links you to.
